eval: (() => { const e = window.__explore, c = window.__life.view().contract; const to = (x, z) => { for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const p = e.pose(), dx = x - p.x, dz = z - p.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (d < 0.15) return; e.look((p.yaw - Math.atan2(-dx, -dz)) / 0.0025, 0); e.move(['w'], Math.min(150, d * 280)); } }; to(c.door.x + 0.5, e.pose().z); to(c.door.x + 0.5, c.exit.z + 0.5); const p = e.pose(); e.look(p.yaw / 0.0025, 0); window.__b17 = {door: c.door, exit: c.exit, lot: c.property[0]}; return e.pose(); })()

(() => { const e = window.__explore, {door} = window.__b17; const w = window.__life.view().scene.world; const gy = (x, z) => { for (let y = Math.floor(e.pose().y) + 3; y > 0; y--) if (w.getBlock(x, y, z) === 0 && w.getBlock(x, y - 1, z) !== 0) return y; return -1; }; const z = Math.floor(e.pose().z) - 3, out = []; for (let i = 3; i >= 0; i--) { const x = door.x + 1 + i, y = gy(x, z); e.aimAt(x + 0.5, y, z + 0.5); out.push(e.placeBlock()); } window.__b17.row = out; return out.map((r) => [r.ok, r.reason, r.cell]); })()

(() => { const w = window.__life.view().scene.world, e = window.__explore; e.look(0, 120); const cells = window.__b17.row.map((r) => ({ ...r.cell, id: w.getBlock(r.cell.x, r.cell.y, r.cell.z) })); const pose = e.pose(); sessionStorage.setItem('b18', JSON.stringify({ cells, pose })); return { cells, pose }; })()

assert: (() => { const w = window.__homesim.getState().world, p = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('b18')).pose; return w.editCount === 4 && Math.abs(w.pose.x - p.x) < 0.01 && Math.abs(w.pose.z - p.z) < 0.01 && Math.abs(w.pose.yaw - p.yaw) < 0.01; })()

(() => { const { cells } = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('b18')); const w = window.__life.view().scene.world; return cells.every((c) => c.id !== 0 && w.getBlock(c.x, c.y, c.z) === c.id) && window.__homesim.getState().world.editCount === 4; })()
